description: This file defines a singleton object TvDpadHelper that provides helper methods for handling D-Pad navigation input events on Android TV platforms, including vertical scrolling and selection key detection.

classes.name: TvDpadHelper
classes.description: A singleton object that centralizes keyboard handling for TV navigation, including vertical scroll handling and determine whether a key is a select action.

methods.name: handleVerticalScroll
methods.description: Handles vertical scrolling events triggered by UP and DOWN D-Pad keys; executes provided callbacks for up/down actions when key events are ACTION_DOWN.

methods.name: isSelect
methods.description: Checks whether the given key code corresponds to a selection key (DPAD_CENTER or ENTER).
